cards.card_text: So what is Israel supposed to do with the altars, sacred stones and Asherah poles in the land?
cards.verse_text: Rather, you must tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …tear down their altars, smash their sacred stones, and chop down their Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: Then Moses gives Israel a to-do list for the altars, sacred pillars and Asherah poles in the land: tear them down, smash them, cut them down.
cards.verse_text: Instead, this is what you are to do to them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
cards.snippet: …them: tear down their altars, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.

cards.card_text: Don't set up a wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God.
cards.verse_text: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your God,
cards.snippet: Do not set up any wooden Asherah pole next to the altar you will build for the LORD your…

cards.card_text: They serve the Baals and the Asherahs They stop worshiping anything at all They head back down to Egypt
cards.verse_text: So the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD; they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
cards.snippet: …they forgot the LORD their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

cards.card_text: Baal is a false god, and there's an Asherah pole standing beside his altar.
cards.verse_text: On that very night the LORD said to Gideon, “Take your father’s young bull and a second bull seven years old, tear down your father’s altar to Baal, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.
cards.snippet: …old, tear down your father’s altar to Baal, and cut down the Asherah pole beside it.

cards.card_text: Then he's to offer the second bull as a burnt offering, using the wood of that Asherah pole.
cards.verse_text: And with the wood of the Asherah pole you cut down, take the second bull and offer it as a burnt offering.” So Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the LORD had told him.
cards.snippet: And with the wood of the Asherah pole you cut down, take the second bull and offer it as…

cards.card_text: It's because they've made their Asherah poles, used to worship a false goddess, provoking the LORD to anger.
cards.verse_text: He will uproot Israel from this good land that He gave their fathers, and He will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.
cards.snippet: …He will scatter them beyond the Euphrates, because they have made their Asherah poles, provoking the LORD to anger.

cards.card_text: Judah builds high places, sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
cards.verse_text: They also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
cards.snippet: They also built for themselves high places, sacred pillars, and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

cards.card_text: His own grandmother Maacah has made a detestable Asherah pole.
cards.verse_text: He also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole.
cards.snippet: …from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole.

cards.card_text: An Asherah pole A golden ephod A bronze serpent
cards.verse_text: Then he set up an Asherah pole.
cards.snippet: Then he set up an Asherah pole.

cards.card_text: Elijah also wants Ahab to bring the prophets of Baal and of Asherah, two false gods.
cards.verse_text: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
cards.snippet: …hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

cards.card_text: He wants the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel's table, plus ONE Elijah.
cards.verse_text: Now summon all Israel to meet me on Mount Carmel, along with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”
cards.snippet: …hundred and fifty prophets of Baal and the four hundred prophets of Asherah who eat at Jezebel’s table.”

cards.card_text: They keep walking in those same sins, and the Asherah pole, a pole for a false goddess, even stays standing in Samaria.
cards.verse_text: The Asherah pole even remained standing in Samaria.
cards.snippet: The Asherah pole even remained standing in Samaria.

cards.card_text: Where do they set up sacred pillars and Asherah poles?
cards.verse_text: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.
cards.snippet: They set up for themselves sacred pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill and under every green tree.

cards.card_text: Along with an Asherah pole, what idols does Israel make for themselves?
cards.verse_text: They abandoned all the commandments of the LORD their God and made for themselves two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole.
cards.snippet: …God and made for themselves two cast idols of calves and an Asherah pole.

cards.card_text: And Hezekiah goes to work: he removes the high places, shatters the sacred pillars, and then turns to the Asherah poles.
cards.verse_text: He removed the high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …removed the high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: What does he do to the Asherah poles?
cards.verse_text: He removed the high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …removed the high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and cut down the Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: He makes an Asherah pole, as King Ahab of Israel had done, and he worships and serves all the host of heaven.
cards.verse_text: He made an Asherah pole, as King Ahab of Israel had done, and he worshiped and served all the host of heaven.
cards.snippet: He made an Asherah pole, as King Ahab of Israel had done, and he worshiped and…

cards.card_text: Then Manasseh even takes the carved Asherah pole he made and sets it up in the temple itself.
cards.verse_text: Manasseh even took the carved Asherah pole he had made and set it up in the temple, of which the LORD had said to David and his son Solomon, “In this temple and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will establish My Name forever.
cards.snippet: Manasseh even took the carved Asherah pole he had made and set it up in the temple, of…

cards.card_text: The articles made for Baal and Asherah The money the doorkeepers collected The timber bought for the repairs
cards.verse_text: Then the king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, the priests second in rank, and the doorkeepers to remove from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven.
cards.snippet: …from the temple of the LORD all the articles made for Baal, Asherah, and all the host of heaven.

cards.card_text: Next up is the Asherah pole.
cards.verse_text: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and there he burned it, ground it to powder, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
cards.snippet: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside…

cards.card_text: What does Josiah do to the Asherah pole in the Kidron Valley?
cards.verse_text: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside Jerusalem, and there he burned it, ground it to powder, and threw its dust on the graves of the common people.
cards.snippet: He brought the Asherah pole from the house of the LORD to the Kidron Valley outside…

cards.card_text: He also tears down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.
cards.verse_text: He also tore down the quarters of the male shrine prostitutes that were in the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.
cards.snippet: …the house of the LORD, where the women had woven tapestries for Asherah.

cards.card_text: After smashing the sacred pillars and cutting down the Asherah poles, Josiah covers the sites with human bones.
cards.verse_text: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and covered the sites with human bones.
cards.snippet: He smashed the sacred pillars to pieces, cut down the Asherah poles, and covered the sites with human bones.

cards.card_text: At Bethel, Josiah leaves the Asherah pole standing.
cards.verse_text: Then he burned the high place, ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole.
cards.snippet: …he burned the high place, ground it to powder, and burned the Asherah pole.

cards.card_text: And Asa gets to WORK: he removes the foreign altars and high places, shatters the sacred pillars and chops DOWN the Asherah poles.
cards.verse_text: He removed the foreign altars and high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and chopped down the Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …altars and high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and chopped down the Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: Maacah had made a detestable Asherah pole, so Asa chops it down, crushes it, and burns it in the Kidron Valley.
cards.verse_text: King Asa also removed his grandmother Maacah from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole.
cards.snippet: …from her position as queen mother because she had made a detestable Asherah pole.

cards.card_text: The high places and Asherah poles The golden calves of Bethel and Dan The idols of Moab and Ammon
cards.verse_text: And his heart took delight in the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.
cards.snippet: …the ways of the LORD; furthermore, he removed the high places and Asherah poles from Judah.

cards.card_text: He removed the Asherah poles He rebuilt the temple walls He fed the hungry in Judah
cards.verse_text: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.”
cards.snippet: However, some good is found in you, for you have removed the Asherah poles from the land and have set your heart on seeking God.”

cards.card_text: They abandon the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and serve Asherah poles and idols.
cards.verse_text: They abandoned the house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and idols.
cards.snippet: …house of the LORD, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherah poles and idols.

cards.card_text: Along with the high places, Manasseh raises up altars for the Baals and makes Asherah poles.
cards.verse_text: For he rebuilt the high places that his father Hezekiah had torn down, and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles.
cards.snippet: …torn down, and he raised up altars for the Baals and made Asherah poles.

cards.card_text: Then he turns to the Asherah poles, the carved idols and the cast images.
cards.verse_text: He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
cards.snippet: He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust,…

cards.card_text: Josiah shatters the Asherah poles and idols, crushes them to dust and scatters it over the ___ of the people who sacrificed to them.
cards.verse_text: He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust, and scattered them over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
cards.snippet: He shattered the Asherah poles, the carved idols, and the cast images, crushed them to dust,…

cards.card_text: Altars torn down, Asherah poles torn down, idols crushed to powder, all through the land of Israel.
cards.verse_text: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the incense altars throughout the land of Israel.
cards.snippet: He tore down the altars and Asherah poles, crushed the idols to powder, and cut to pieces all the…

cards.card_text: And no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
cards.verse_text: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
cards.snippet: …he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.

cards.card_text: He talks about their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.
cards.verse_text: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.
cards.snippet: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.

cards.card_text: True or false: The LORD says Judah's children have forgotten their altars and Asherah poles.
cards.verse_text: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.
cards.snippet: Even their children remember their altars and Asherah poles by the green trees and on the high hills.

cards.card_text: Then the LORD says, "I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities."
cards.verse_text: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
cards.snippet: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
